{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the value counts of patient_id to see how many times each appears
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()

# Find the maximum number of times a patient appears
max_occurrences = patient_id_counts.max()

# Check how many patients appear more than once
multi_occurrence_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].count()

# Total number of unique patients
num_unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

# Total number of rows (observations)
total_rows = len(df)

# Print results
max_occurrences, multi_occurrence_patients, num_unique_patients, total_rows"}
